nodes.label: AEMS/FineVideo Multimodal Retrieval System
nodes.author: Team 23
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive multimodal video retrieval system using CLIP and CLAP encoders with learned gating networks for dynamic modality weighting

nodes.label: Codebase Structure
nodes.rationale: Organized into src (core library), pipeline (orchestration), bin (executable scripts), experiments (research), and supporting directories

nodes.label: Architecture System Overview
nodes.rationale: Query-conditioned adaptive fusion using precomputed embeddings with learned gating network that predicts per-query modality fusion weights

nodes.label: AEMS Implementation Specification
nodes.rationale: Canonical specification for Phase A implementation: port retrieval pipeline to AEMS corpus with leakage-free evaluation protocol using Q&A questions

nodes.label: Audio Choices and Analysis
nodes.rationale: Root cause analysis of audio performance issues revealing semantic misalignment between audio and text embeddings; proposes angular similarity and temperature scaling improvements

nodes.label: Explainability Module
nodes.rationale: Human-readable explanations for retrieval results covering gating decisions, modality contributions, and ranking differences

nodes.label: GatingNetwork Model
nodes.rationale: MLP architecture (512→128→ReLU→3→Softmax) with ~66K parameters that learns dynamic weights for visual, text, and audio modalities. Replaces equal fusion baseline.

nodes.label: TemporalTransformer Model
nodes.rationale: 2-layer TransformerEncoder over 16 frame embeddings with CLS token and learned positional embeddings. Aggregates frame-level CLIP features to video-level representation.

nodes.label: CLIP Encoder
nodes.rationale: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 for encoding both video frames and text. Produces 512-dimensional normalized embeddings used in visual and text branches.

nodes.label: CLAP Encoder
nodes.rationale: LAION CLAP audio encoder for encoding audio segments. Produces 512-dimensional normalized embeddings for audio similarity computation.

nodes.label: QueryRouter
nodes.rationale: Detects query type (text/image/audio/video/mixed), performs multimodal encoding via CLIP/CLAP, and computes per-modality similarity scores

nodes.label: Explainability Module
nodes.rationale: Four functions: explain_gating_decision, explain_modality_contributions, explain_ranking_difference, format_explanation. Provides human-readable interpretability of system decisions.

nodes.label: MSR-VTT Dataset
nodes.rationale: Original benchmark dataset with 10K videos. Used to develop and validate the retrieval architecture. Honest LOO evaluation shows equal fusion R@1=43.03%.

nodes.label: AEMS Corpus
nodes.rationale: New dataset with 6,307 videos across 17 content categories. Enables structurally leakage-free evaluation using Q&A questions separate from text database. Stratified 85/15 split per category.

nodes.label: Leakage-Free Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Uses Q&A questions as test queries (structurally disjoint from description+transcript text database). Ensures no exact-text leakage between queries and retrieval database.

nodes.label: Frame Extraction (16 Uniform Frames)
nodes.rationale: Extract exactly 16 uniformly-spaced frames from each video via ffmpeg. Input to TemporalTransformer. More consistent than variable fps-based extraction.

nodes.label: Three-Segment Audio Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extract three 10-second segments (begin, middle, end) from audio at 48kHz. Better than center-10s for long educational AEMS content. Segments averaged L2-normalized per-segment.

nodes.label: Text Fusion Strategy (F-Mean)
nodes.rationale: Fuse text_description and text_transcript as mean-of-means: normalize(0.5*e_desc + 0.5*e_trans). Weights description and transcript equally regardless of transcript length. Addresses CLIP 77-token limit.

nodes.label: Text Chunking (72-Token Budget)
nodes.rationale: Split long transcripts into non-overlapping ≤72-token windows (CLIP 77-token limit minus 5-token safety margin). Encode each chunk and average embeddings.

nodes.label: Stratified 85/15 Split per Category
nodes.rationale: Deterministic per-category stratification (seed=42 + category_index) ensures balanced representation. Yields ~5,361 train and ~946 test videos across 17 categories.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
nodes.rationale: 1000-iteration bootstrap resampling with replacement to compute 95% CIs for R@1/5/10. Enables statistical significance testing between systems.

nodes.label: Audio-Text Semantic Misalignment Problem
nodes.rationale: CLAP audio embeddings poorly aligned with CLIP text embeddings. Root cause: different training data and semantic spaces. Manifests as 50% negative similarities and near-zero audio gating weight.

nodes.label: Angular Similarity (Audio Improvement)
nodes.rationale: Replaces cosine similarity with angular similarity for audio-text matching. Shows 79x improvement in meaningful matches (27K high similarities vs 80 with cosine). Mean increases from -0.0747 to 0.4761.

nodes.label: Temperature Scaling (Similarity Adjustment)
nodes.rationale: Apply temperature scaling (T=0.1-0.5 optimal) to similarity distributions. Lower temperatures compress distribution and improve ranking quality for audio.

nodes.label: Category-Stratified Recall Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Report R@1/5/10 per content_fine_category. Reveals category-specific strengths/weaknesses (e.g., text-heavy categories vs audio-heavy ones).

nodes.label: build_aems_manifest.py
nodes.rationale: Production script that walks AEMS dataset, applies stratified 85/15 split per category, writes manifest with video metadata and text fields

nodes.label: extract_aems_frames.py
nodes.rationale: Extracts 16 uniform frames per video using ffmpeg. Resume-friendly: skips videos with existing valid frames.

nodes.label: extract_aems_audio.py
nodes.rationale: Extracts three 10-second audio segments at 48kHz. Handles short videos by encode-once-reuse pattern. Outputs full demuxed audio.

nodes.label: precompute_aems_video_embeddings.py
nodes.rationale: CLIP-encodes frames and produces mean-pooled 512-dim video embedding per video. Output: aems_video_embeddings_v1.pt

nodes.label: precompute_aems_audio_embeddings.py
nodes.rationale: CLAP-encodes three audio segments, averages normalized embeddings. Output: aems_audio_embeddings_v1.pt

nodes.label: precompute_aems_text_embeddings.py
nodes.rationale: CLIP-encodes text in three fusion variants: description-only (D), transcript-chunked-mean (T), fused (F). Outputs three .pt files per split.

nodes.label: train_aems_temporal_transformer.py
nodes.rationale: Trains TemporalTransformer on frame embeddings with InfoNCE loss. Uses text_description as supervision (clean, CLIP-safe). Outputs best checkpoint to models/aems_temporal_transformer_best_v1.pth

nodes.label: export_aems_transformer_embeddings.py
nodes.rationale: Loads frozen best transformer checkpoint, runs forward pass on all videos, exports embeddings. Output: aems_video_embeddings_transformer_v1.pt

nodes.label: train_aems_gating.py
nodes.rationale: Trains GatingNetwork on Q&A questions with ranking loss (margin=0.2). Uses frozen transformer/meanpool embeddings. Output: models/aems_gating_weights_v1.pth

nodes.label: eval_aems_retrieval.py
nodes.rationale: Unified five-system evaluation: visual-only, text-only, audio-only, equal-fusion, adaptive-gating. Computes R@1/5/10 with bootstrap CIs and category stratification. Auto-generates summary table.

nodes.label: AEMSDataset Class
nodes.rationale: PyTorch Dataset subclass. Returns dict with raw PIL images (not preprocessed), raw text fields (description, transcript, qa_questions, qa_answers), and audio_path. Dumb loader: no encoder dependency.

nodes.label: src/config.py Constants
nodes.rationale: Centralized configuration: AEMS_MANIFEST_PATH, AEMS_FRAMES_DIR, AEMS_AUDIO_DIR, MAX_CLIP_TEXT_TOKENS=77, CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET=72, embedding path templates

nodes.label: AEMS Pipeline Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Main entry point: python pipeline/run_aems_pipeline.py. Coordinates all 8 stages: manifest → frames → audio → video embeddings → text embeddings → transformer training → gating training → evaluation
